calibration_sources: NVIDIA H200 (141GB HBM3e) vs. H100 (80GB) vs. A100 (80GB) vs. L40S (48GB) TensorRT-LLM & vLLM Serving Benchmarks
Azure ND_H200_v5 / NCads_H100_v5 / NC_A100_v4 & AWS p5e / g6e / g5 Cloud Instance Pricing & Roofline Models
Llama-3.3-70B & Qwen-2.5-32B/72B FP8 KV Cache Memory & Bandwidth Sizing Formulas

workload.enterprise_scenario: Enterprise Production LLM Serving Sizer across 8B (SLM/Router), 32B (Coding/Agent), and 70B (Flagship Llama-3.3-70B / Qwen-2.5-72B) with 8,192 Context Length
workload.target_sla: P99 TTFT <= 800 ms, P99 Decode TPOT <= 20.0 ms (50+ tok/s/user)
workload.first_principles_sizing_formula: Total_VRAM >= Model_Weights + (Concurrent_Users * Context_Len * KV_Bytes_Per_Token) + Activation_Overhead; Decode_TPOT ~= Active_Weight_Bytes / Effective_HBM_Bandwidth + AllReduce_Latency

tiers.name: Tier 1: 入门级推理卡 A10G / L4 (24GB GDDR6 · AWS g5 / g6 · $1.05/hr)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Entry PCIe GPU A10G / L4 (24GB GDDR6 · 300–600 GB/s · $1.05/hr)
tiers.hardware_profile: 24 GB GDDR6 (600 GB/s on A10G, 300 GB/s on L4), PCIe Gen4, No NVLink
tiers.recommended_for: 7B/8B SLM & Embedding/Reranker serving at low-to-moderate concurrency (<16 sessions); cannot host 70B without 4-GPU PCIe TP=4 bottleneck.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 存量双卡 2×A100 80GB SXM4 跑 70B BF16 (无原生 FP8 · 仅剩 20GB KV 显存陷阱)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Legacy 2x A100 80GB SXM4 Running 70B BF16 (No Hardware FP8 · 20GB KV Trap)
tiers.hardware_profile: 2x A100 80GB (160 GB HBM2e, 2.0 TB/s/GPU, $6.40/hr for 2 GPUs, Lacks Native FP8)
tiers.recommended_for: Anti-pattern for 70B BF16: 140GB weights consume 87.5% of 160GB VRAM, starving KV cache (only 18 sessions) and inflating token cost to $2.45/1M.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 中端性价比之王 L40S 48GB PCIe (Ada 原生 FP8 · 8B/32B 黄金机型 · $1.85/hr)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Mid-Range Price-Performance King L40S 48GB PCIe (Ada Native FP8 for 8B & 32B)
tiers.hardware_profile: 1x–2x L40S 48GB GDDR6 (864 GB/s, 733 TFLOPS FP8 Tensor Core, $1.85/GPU-hr)
tiers.recommended_for: Best ROI for 7B/8B and 32B FP8/AWQ models (1x L40S fits 32B FP8 with 16GB KV cache at $1.85/hr); avoid TP>=4 across PCIe for 70B.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 旗舰单卡 H200 141GB (或双卡 H100 FP8) 跑 70B FP8 (4.8 TB/s HBM3e · 71GB KV 巨量池)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Flagship 1x H200 141GB (or 2x H100 FP8) Running 70B FP8 (4.8 TB/s HBM3e · 84 Sessions)
tiers.hardware_profile: 1x H200 141GB HBM3e (4.8 TB/s, 1,979 TFLOPS FP8, $4.50/GPU-hr, Zero TP AllReduce Overhead!)
tiers.recommended_for: Enterprise 70B/72B production standard: 1x H200 fits full 70B FP8 (70GB) + 66GB FP8 KV cache on a single GPU with zero cross-GPU TP overhead.
